summaries.summary: This slide illustrates a collaboration example between Diabetes UK, Garfield Weston Foundation, and Nonsense to create an online resource called #Type1Uncut for young people with Type 1 diabetes. It highlights that Diabetes UK was already running meetups and that Nonsense helped create the resource through workshops with young people. The project now produces videos on YouTube.
key_facts: Diabetes UK collaborated with Garfield Weston Foundation and Nonsense to create #Type1Uncut.
Diabetes UK was already running meetups for young people with Type 1 diabetes.
Nonsense was hired to help create the resource through workshops with young people.
Videos are now published on YouTube at youtube.com/typeluncut.
visible_text: COLLABORATION EXAMPLE...
#typeluncut started with Garfield Weston Foundation getting together with Diabetes UK to provide an online resource for young people with Type1 diabetes.
Diabetes UK were already running meetups for groups of these young people.

They hired Nonsense to help create the resource... the first thing we did was run workshops with the young people, who not only told us what content they really needed, but also volunteered to help make it!
They now make and publish videos on the subjects they really care about on youtube.com/typeluncut
